title: Eventual Morse Minimality of Heat Flow on Lens Spaces
summary: We prove that heat flow generically produces Morse-minimal functions on round lens spaces. The result gives a rigorous explanation of a phenomenon first suggested by computational experiments: after high-frequency modes have been suppressed by diffusion, generic heat evolutions on lens spaces tend to settle into Morse functions with the smallest possible number of critical points.
